user.title: Connect to Aquastilla
user.description: Sign in with the e-mail address and password of your Aquastilla app account. Signing in with Google, Apple or Facebook cannot be used here: set a password for the account with the app's password reset first.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved password for {email} was rejected. Enter the current password.

error.invalid_auth: The e-mail address or password was rejected.
error.cannot_connect: The Aquastilla service could not be reached. Try again later.
error.no_devices: This account has no device. Add the softener in the Aquastilla app first.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. See the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That password belongs to a different account.

init.title: Polling
init.description: How often Home Assistant asks the Aquastilla service for new data. The service belongs to the vendor, so five minutes is the default and fresher data is not available by asking more often.
